name: kpiScorecard
title: KPI Scorecard
description: Executive scorecard: one row per KPI with result, latest month, target, a coloured status chip and a sparkline

category.description: One row per value, for example the KPI name.

trend.description: Optional. A date or month column for the sparkline.

result.description: The headline result per row (number or text).

latest.description: Optional. The value in the latest period (number or text).

target.description: Optional. The target per row (number or text, e.g. "≥ 95%").

status.description: Optional. Status text (On track / At risk / Off track) or a number (1 good, 0 at risk, -1 off).

values.description: Optional. The measure drawn as the sparkline along the trend axis.

tooltips.description: Extra measures shown in the tooltip.
